name: leaveflow
description: Vacation request management — TravelFactory home assignment

scripts.setup: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w @leaveflow/api" "npm run dev -w @leaveflow/web"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run codegen:check -w @leaveflow/api && npm test
